Cements Limited |access-date=28 May 2025}} }} '''Ambuja Cements Limited''', formerly known as '''Gujarat Ambuja Cement Limited''' ('''GACL'''), is an Indian [[cement]] producing company, which markets cement and clinker for both domestic and export markets. ==History== The company entered into a strategic partnership with Holcim, the second-largest cement manufacturer in the world from 2006. Holcim had, in January, bought a 14.8 percent promoters' stake in the GACL for [[Indian rupee|₹]]2,140 [[crore]].{{cite web|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2005/01/21/stories/2005012102690100.htm |title=Swiss co Holcim cements deal with Ambuja for ACC |publisher=The Hindu Business Line |date=21 January 2005 |accessdate=16 July 2010}} From 2010 to 2022, [[Holcim]] held a 61.62% [[controlling stake]] in Ambuja Cements.{{cite web |url=http://wap.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/lafargeholcim-acquires-shares-worth-rs-1-832-cr-in-ambuja-acc-116111601129_1.html|title=Swiss co Holcim cements deal with Ambuja for ACC |publisher= Business Standard |date=16 November 2016}} On 14 April 2022, Holcim announced that it would exit from the Indian market after 17 years of operations as part of a strategy to focus on core markets, and listed its stakes in Ambuja Cements and [[ACC (company)|ACC]] for sale.{{Cite news |last=Barman |first=Arijit |title=JSW taps Carlyle to back bid for Holcim's Indian cement operations |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/cement/jsw-taps-carlyle-to-back-bid-for-holcims-indian-cement-operations/articleshow/90968721.cms |access-date=2022-04-21}} On 15 May 2022, [[Adani Group]] acquired Holcim's stake in Ambuja Cements and ACC for US$10.5 billion.{{Cite news |last=Mishra |first=Lalatendu |date=2022-05-15 |title=Adani buys Ambuja, ACC for $10.5 billion |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/adani-family-to-acquire-holcims-stake-in-ambuja-cement-acc-in-105-billion-deal/article65417633.ece |access-date=2022-05-16 |issn=0971-751X}} In August 2023, Ambuja Cement acquired Sanghi Industries at an enterprise value of {{INR}}5,000 crore.{{cite news |title=Ambuja Cements buys Sanghi Industries for ₹5,767 crore |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/ambuja-cements-buys-sanghi-industries-for-5767-crore/article67154359.ece |access-date=28 May 2025 |work=BusinessLine |date=3 August 2023 |language=en}} In June 2024, Ambuja Cements acquired [[Hyderabad]]-based Penna Cement Industries at an enterprise value of {{INR}}10,422 crore.{{cite news |title=Ambuja Cements to acquire Penna Cement for Rs 10,422 crore |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/companies/ambuja-cements-to-acquire-penna-cement-for-rs-10422-cr-9391374/ |access-date=28 May 2025 |work=The Indian Express |date=14 June 2024 |language=en}} In October 2024, Ambuja Cement acquired [[CK Birla Group]]'s Orient Cement at an approximate value of {{INR}}8,100 crore.{{cite web |title=Adani Group's Acquires CK Birla's Orient Cement at INR 8,100 Crore |url=https://www.brutimes.com/news/business/adani-groups-acquires-ck-birlas-orient-cement-at-inr-8100-crore |website=Bru Times News |language=en}}{{cite web |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/cement/ambuja-to-acquire-orient-cement-at-equity-value-of-rs-8100-crore-to-make-open-offer-to-acquire-additional-26-stake/articleshow/114446535.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=22 October 2024}} ==Controversies== === Trademark litigation === In September 2025, Ambuja Cements initiated a trademark infringement lawsuit against [[JSW Cement]] in the [[Delhi High Court]]. The company alleged that JSW's "Jal Kavach" water-repellent cement was deceptively similar to its "Ambuja Kawach" brand, which was registered in 2019. Ambuja sought a permanent injunction and damages, citing phonetic and visual similarities in branding. The court subsequently referred both parties to mediation to explore a potential out-of-court settlement.https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/ambuja-cements-jsw-cement-trademark-dispute-11758096851844.html === Sanghi Industries Acquisition Dispute === Following its ₹5,185 crore acquisition of Sanghi Industries in December 2023, Ambuja Cements entered a legal dispute with Sanghi's former promoter, Alok Sanghi. The dispute arose after Ambuja Cements invoked a personal guarantee to demand ₹84 crore from Sanghi for pre-acquisition liabilities concerning an unpaid electricity bill. Ambuja Cements initiated personal insolvency proceedings against Sanghi under Section 95 of the [[Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016|Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code]] (IBC) before the Ahmedabad bench of the [[National Company Law Tribunal]] (NCLT). Sanghi contested the action before the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT), maintaining that the 2023 share purchase agreement outlined corporate warranties and indemnities rather than personal guarantees. The litigation concluded in May 2026 after both parties reached an out-of-court settlement, resulting in the mutual withdrawal of the petitions before both tribunals.{{cite news |title=Former Sanghi Industries promoter settles dispute with Ambuja Cements, withdraws NCLAT plea |url=https://legal.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/web-stories/alok-sanghi-settles-dispute-with-ambuja-cements-withdraws-nclat-plea/131429283 |work=The Economic Times (ETLegalWorld) |agency=PTI |date=June 1, 2026 |access-date=June 3, 2026}}https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/former-sanghi-industries-promoter-settles-dispute-with-ambuja-cements-126053100258_1.html ==Gallery== File:Ambuja Tower.jpg|Ambuja Tower corporate office in [[Ahmedabad]] File:Ambuja cement company in beautiful location.jpg|Ambuja Cements plant in [[Darlaghat]], [[Himachal Pradesh]] File:Ambuja Cements Limited 20020400.jpg|Ambuja Cements grinding unit in [[Howrah]] ==See also== {{Portal|Companies}} * [[Tarachand Ghanshyamdas]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *{{Official}} {{Holcim}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} [[Category: Cement companies of India]] [[Category:1986 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies established in 1986]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1986]] [[Category:Holcim Group]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Adani Group]]
